scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.deploy:ready: npm ci && npm run db:deploy-ready && npm run build
